raw.story:
You dock at Grand Exchange Station. Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Federation takes its cut of everything.

The lanes around Grand Exchange Station are crowded and quick, traffic control clipped and constant. Cargo handlers move like clockwork, and a tariff assessor is already pricing your manifest. Drifting in, you make out a couple of mid-sized ships working cargo at the goods-transfer quays, Reserves trading the lanes with Deeprock Harvesters, a pair of small ships skating across the Promenade hangar bays, busy at every hour, Caravans trading the lanes with Arbitrages, and scores of light craft flitting between the same berths, the bulk of them Prospects. The station fields a handful of Federation Overheads working overwatch from these docks and a hundred-strong crowd of Federation Eviction Notices holding station as a show of force. Traffic control also tracks countless craft mothballed tucked into the bonded consignment berths. Hard to miss, eight or nine Junk Convoys — laid up until a buyer or a war calls them back. You pick out the Blackfeathers Justice among the hulls at berth.

faction_facilities.description: A shared data terminal for pooling scanner results and scouting reports. Members submit system data manually using faction_submit_intel. A submission keeps only the POIs on the submitter's own charts; an unknown or uncharted POI ID is dropped. Hand-submitted resource readings carry no read_at_tick, so they always read as unverified, and they only refresh when someone resubmits. Upgrade to Intel Center (L2) to record what members' ships read automatically.
faction_facilities.name: Intel Terminal

faction_facilities.description: A compact pressurization and compression line that condenses liquid hydrogen into fuel reserves. Copper piping carries cryogenic feed through steel-plated containment chambers with basic flow control.
faction_facilities.name: H2 Fuel Combustor

faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Office

faction_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

faction_facilities.description: A specialized molding facility that combines polymers and carbon ore through controlled heating and pressure. Copper piping distributes heat while control nodes manage the extrusion cycles that form nanoplastic composites.
faction_facilities.name: Polymer Extruder

faction_facilities.description: A secured fuel storage tank accessible only to faction members. Fill it from your own production facilities or deposit fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel), and your fleet refuels for free.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Fuel Bunker

faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.
faction_facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace

faction_facilities.description: Climate-controlled storage bay with proper inventory tracking. Room for serious stockpiling.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Warehouse

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.
faction_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

faction_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
faction_facilities.name: Hiring Board

faction_facilities.description: Specialized furnace and drawing tower for converting silicon ore and energy crystals into ultra-pure optical fiber, a precision process requiring stable temperature control.
faction_facilities.name: Fiber Draw Tower

public_facilities.description: Reactor fitted with a platinum catalyst bed that cracks organic feedstock far more completely than an open vat, drawing twice the polymer from the same synthetic compound.

public_facilities.description: A specialized compression vessel designed to stabilize and compress plasma gas into fuel reserves. Heavy steel construction and basic control systems manage the containment pressure.

public_facilities.description: A modest assembly bay that flat-packs hardened lockboxes, fuel bladders, and mooring spars into deployable outpost kits. A fraction of the scale a Station Core Foundry demands — within reach of a young faction that wants a presence out in the lawless dark.

station_facilities.description: A specialized production line that fuses processed null matter onto circuit board substrates. Precision control nodes manage the exotic bonding process required to create stable quantum stabilizers.
station_facilities.name: Quantum Stabilizer Assembly Line

station_facilities.description: A specialized assembly facility that integrates circuit boards, crystals, and palladium into multi-spectrum detection arrays for surveillance and targeting systems.
station_facilities.name: Sensor Array Production Line

station_facilities.description: An expanded catalytic line with automated hydrogen handling and pressure sealing, turning out fuel cells in larger runs while keeping the catalyst bed efficient.
station_facilities.name: Catalytic Fuel Cell Workshop

station_facilities.description: A proper turret on a proper mount, throwing armor-piercing shot out to the middle distance. The workhorse of station defense: not clever, not fast, and entirely capable of putting a hole through a raider that thought a station was a soft target. The turret tracks smoothly through its arc, ready racks full.
station_facilities.name: Station Defense Turret

station_facilities.description: A fleet-scale mobilization center capable of assembling and assigning thousands of qualified spacers. Reserve halls stand half empty and assignment traffic backs up behind shortages in food, power, and transport.
station_facilities.name: Fleet Personnel Command

station_facilities.description: Advanced life support with comfort-optimized environmental controls. The air is mountain-fresh, the water tastes clean, and the temperature is always perfect across all commercial districts. Happy traders spend more.
station_facilities.name: Haven Ecosync

station_facilities.description: A processing line that assembles nickel-metal-hydride cells into power batteries, casting electrodes and welding terminals while copper-piped coolant holds temperatures in check.
station_facilities.name: NiMH Battery Line

station_facilities.description: Officially regulatory, functionally a matchmaking service. Every job has a client, a fee structure, and a satisfaction guarantee. Contract-matching algorithms run at full efficiency, cipher-verified deals closing across all five empires. The arbitration panel hasn't been needed in weeks.
station_facilities.name: Haven Trade Commission

station_facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: State-of-the-art fully automated facility with redundant cooling systems, precision plasma injection arrays, and real-time pressure regulation—delivers fuel reserves at maximum throughput with minimal thermal losses.
station_facilities.name: H2 Fuel Hub

station_facilities.description: Cuts raw trade crystals into cryptographic cipher chips — Stage 1 of Haven's two-step transaction verification monopoly.
station_facilities.name: Haven Cipher Foundry

station_facilities.description: A dark, damp fungal cellar running a gloomcap flush down to a thick mash.
station_facilities.name: Gloomcap Cellar

station_facilities.description: Station-scale artillery. The shells are the size of a shuttle's engine bell and they reach all the way out to the edge of the engagement, which means there is nowhere in the fight a ship can sit and be safe from it. The recoil is taken by the station's own mass, because nothing smaller would survive it. The loading crews are working and the barrels are warm. Anything in the volume is in range.
station_facilities.name: Heavy Defense Battery

station_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
station_facilities.name: Hiring Board

station_facilities.description: A decompression rig that cracks bell-jelly float-sacs into standard fuel cells.
station_facilities.name: Levity Gas Cracker

station_facilities.description: Specialized machinery for forming and welding steel plates with titanium reinforcement. Handles liquid hydrogen integration with basic containment protocols.
station_facilities.name: Steel Pressure Vessel

station_facilities.description: An auxiliary processing pod plumbed into the station's existing life support loop. Scales up whatever's already there — supported population and resource consumption rise together with each module attached. The pod cycles in tandem with the primary system, drawing its share of inputs and adding its share of capacity. Environmental sensors stay green.
station_facilities.name: Life Support Expansion

station_facilities.description: Dedicated furnace reducing aluminum ore into molten metal and casting into sheet stock. Basic thermal management via copper piping maintains consistent melt temperature throughout production.
station_facilities.name: Aluminum Smelter

station_facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

station_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
station_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

station_facilities.description: Risotto pans and ink-tempering rigs, stained permanently blue.
station_facilities.name: Cobalt Ink Risotto Galley

station_facilities.description: Some guy you hired to yell at passing ship pilots about your faction's buy orders. Surprisingly effective.
station_facilities.name: Market Runner

station_facilities.description:
A narrow bunk wedged between a star chart cabinet and a portable spectrometer that hums when the station's power grid hiccups. The walls are covered in hand-annotated system maps — some printed, some sketched on whatever paper was available. Red circles mark unexplored nebula POIs. Blue lines trace jump routes. One corner is labeled "WORMHOLE CANDIDATES" in capital letters, with Merak crossed out and "CONFIRMED" written next to it.

A battered fuel cell sits on the shelf above the bunk — a reminder, not a spare. The locker door has "LYRA VOSS — HRZN" scratched into the metal with something sharp.

The bunk itself is impeccably made. Explorers sleep clean when they can.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: A basic filtration and melting plant that converts water ice into purified liquid for station systems. Simple heat management and control circuitry handle routine ice processing.
station_facilities.name: Ice Melt Pit

station_facilities.description: A dedicated production line integrating shield emitters, superconductors, crystals, and circuits into enhanced capacity modules. Control nodes manage the precision assembly of booster components.
station_facilities.name: Shield Booster II Workshop

station_facilities.description: A basic hydrogen-fusion cell fabrication station that combines liquid hydrogen with steel plates into standardized power cells. Simple heating and containment produce steady fuel-cell output.
station_facilities.name: Fuel Cell Workshop

station_facilities.description: Dedicated argon ionization facility with electromagnetic compression arrays and copper-wound containment coils. Fuel cells power the high-voltage ionization equipment.
station_facilities.name: Argon Compression Plant

station_facilities.description: A physical notice board near the docks. Your posted bounties compete for attention with lost pet notices and propaganda.
station_facilities.name: Notice Board

station_facilities.description: A controlled thermal-processing station that extracts and bonds palladium and iridium ore with copper wiring to form zero-resistance conductors. Copper piping and control nodes manage the delicate metallurgical reactions required.
station_facilities.name: Precious-Metal Refinery

station_facilities.description: Industrial power cell fabrication line with lead shielding and radiation containment. Handles enriched uranium rods and copper wiring in a controlled, purpose-built environment.
station_facilities.name: Nuclear Cell Foundry

station_facilities.description: A spinal energy weapon run the length of a station module, firing rarely and arriving like a decision. It takes a long time to charge and it drinks power the whole while, and what it hits generally stops being a coherent object. Stations that own one tend to be stations that have already been raided once. The capacitor stack is charged and the coolant loops are running cold. The lance is ready.
station_facilities.name: Siege Lance

station_facilities.description: An assembly line that mounts trade-crystal focusing optics directly into circuit-board detection arrays — skipping the focused-crystal intermediate that other sensor lines depend on.
station_facilities.name: Crystal Optic Sensor Line

station_facilities.description: A specialized high-temperature refining line equipped with plasma injection and heat management systems to blend Sol alloy ore into advanced composite material.
station_facilities.name: Solarian Composite Forge

station_facilities.description: A Nebula-pattern cutting bench that cleaves raw trade crystals along their natural lattice planes and polishes the facets into weapon-ready focusing optics. Palladium-free precision — the crystal's own structure does the focusing.
station_facilities.name: Trade Crystal Facetry

station_facilities.description: Zero-gravity production of Nebula Stellar Vintage. Luminescent algae cultures, trade crystal filtration, and a Federation price tag.
station_facilities.name: Haven Vintner Complex

station_facilities.description: Wet-chemistry vats and hand-wound separators for packing raw lithium into power cells. Slow, ore-hungry, and completely indifferent to the circuit board market.
station_facilities.name: Lithium Cell Foundry

station_facilities.description: A capital-scale command and training complex able to mobilize marine formations for sustained fleet operations. Mobilization halls sit under strength and advanced training blocks are suspended for lack of supplies.
station_facilities.name: Expeditionary Warfare Command

station_facilities.description: Massive underground fuel reservoir with multi-redundant containment, automated distribution rails, and real-time telemetry. Capacity to service entire fleets without interruption. All containment layers sealed. Distribution rails primed. The reservoir holds enough fuel to service a fleet — and then some.
station_facilities.name: Capital Fuel Bunker

station_facilities.description: Massive solar collection array bathed in constant light from Haven's binary star. Binary starlight floods the collection panels, power output steady and surplus feeding the grid. The most efficient generation in settled space.
station_facilities.name: Nebula Solar Array

station_facilities.description: A focused thermal processing line with controlled heating and alloying injection, converting raw titanium ore into finished alloy for hull applications.
station_facilities.name: Alloy Foundry

station_facilities.description: Specialized reactor integrating null matter, Solarian composite, and trade cipher components into unified circuit lattice. Combines exotic materials through controlled plasma injection and thermal precision.
station_facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Workshop

station_facilities.description: Capital-grade belt armor, of the kind normally reserved for things that are expected to be shot at by other capital ships. Bolting it to a station is an enormous, ostentatious statement about how the next raid is expected to go. The belt is intact. Small-calibre fire is not registering as damage so much as weather.
station_facilities.name: Bulwark Plating

station_facilities.description: A cramped desk in a shared office, wedged between a water recycler and someone's lunch. It's official, technically. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — less paperwork, more efficiency — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
station_facilities.name: Faction Desk

station_facilities.description: Specialized production line combining processing cores and sensor arrays with circuit boards and focused crystals into astrogation computers. Control nodes manage the precise integration required for hyperspace calculations.
station_facilities.name: Astrogation Core Assembly

station_facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: A dusty logbook chained to a desk in the corner of the trading floor. Members jot down prices they saw at other stations — not always accurate, but better than nothing.
station_facilities.name: Trade Ledger

station_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing and compressing purified argon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
station_facilities.name: Argon Cell Lab

station_facilities.description: A cocktail station tuned for colour-shifting prism-charged ichor.
station_facilities.name: Prism-Charged Cocktail Bar

station_facilities.description: A production line that packs nickel billets and copper wiring into nickel-metal-hydride power cells through automated electrode rolling, electrolyte filling, and containment.
station_facilities.name: NiMH Cell Line

station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.name: Heavy Defense Battery

station_facilities.description: A basic shaft furnace that roasts and smelts low-grade nickel ore into cast billets. Copper piping carries coolant past the crucible while simple controls hold the burn steady — slow, but it turns ore piles into usable metal.
station_facilities.name: Nickel Smelter

station_facilities.description: A dedicated fabrication line that assembles universal docking collars from durasteel plates and titanium alloy. Control nodes and power distribution circuits ensure reliable ship-to-station interface.
station_facilities.name: Coupling Workshop

station_facilities.description: Basic thermal polymerization system for ore conversion. Heats and combines silicon and nickel feedstock into flexible synthetic material.
station_facilities.name: Polymer Synthesizer

station_facilities.description: A cheerful fuel plaza with competitive pricing and complimentary hull washes. Commerce extends to everything at Haven. Bright signage gleams, pumps cycling efficiently, the loyalty program terminal processing credits smoothly. Complimentary hull washes run on schedule.
station_facilities.name: Haven Fuel Plaza

station_facilities.description: A basic hydrogen-fusion cell fabrication station that combines liquid hydrogen with steel plates into standardized power cells. Simple heating and containment produce steady fuel-cell output.
station_facilities.name: Hydrogen Combustion Chamber

Scales up whatever's already there — supported population and resource consumption rise together with each module attached. The pod cycles in tandem with the primary system, drawing its share of inputs and adding its share of capacity. Environmental sensors stay green.
station_facilities.name: Life Support Expansion

station_facilities.description: Purpose-built kiln system with staged heating chambers and plasma-assisted sintering. Heat sinks regulate the bonding process while increased throughput allows parallel batch processing of alumina composites.
station_facilities.name: Alumina Ceramite Kiln

station_facilities.description: A sprawling multi-bay complex staffed by mechanics from every empire. They'll fix anything, and the waiting lounge has a bar. All bays operational, multi-empire crews working in coordinated shifts. Diagnostics run clean, structural work finishes on schedule, and the bar is open.
station_facilities.name: Haven Repair Complex

station_facilities.description: A capital-scale hospital complex combining automated surgery, regeneration therapy, and fleet casualty logistics. Whole treatment blocks are offline, leaving advanced beds idle while conventional wards overflow.
station_facilities.name: Regenerative Medical Complex

station_facilities.description: Higher-capacity facility with expanded processing core arrays and structural reinforcement to handle increased throughput. Sensor arrays and control nodes are staged through dedicated assembly stations.
station_facilities.name: Sensor Assembly Line

station_facilities.description: A specialized refining line that subjects power cells and purified argon to controlled plasma injection and heat cycling, fusing them with synthetic diamond to form stable energy crystals.
station_facilities.name: Crystal Synthesis Line

station_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

station_facilities.description: Zero-gravity bioluminescent algae cultivation tanks feeding Haven's luxury production chains.
station_facilities.name: Haven Algae Cultivation

station_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
station_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

station_facilities.description: A staged distillation column with cryo-separation that wrings far more fuel out of each canister of crystallized bio-gas. A serious fuel supplier for a hunting frontier.
station_facilities.name: Biogas Distillation Plant

station_facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

station_facilities.description: A precision containment and treatment unit that stabilizes raw null matter through controlled electromagnetic and plasma conditioning for stealth applications.
station_facilities.name: Null Matter Processing Vat

station_facilities.description: A focused production line that integrates circuit boards and crystals into complete sensor packages. Copper piping carries control signals through the assembly stages.
station_facilities.name: Sensor Package Assembly Line

station_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

station_facilities.description: A high-pressure anvil system that applies extreme force and heat to raw carbon ore, forming synthetic diamond crystals through controlled phase transition. Produces cut diamonds at measured intervals.
station_facilities.name: Carbon Press

station_facilities.description: Specialized production line assembling flex-polymer housings, circuit boards, and water-recycling cores into integrated life-support units. Control nodes manage fluid flow and electrical integration in sequence.
station_facilities.name: Atmosphere Scrubber

station_facilities.description: A noodle-pulling line and ink bath for dockside street bowls.
station_facilities.name: Cobalt Squid Noodles Galley

station_facilities.description: A compact freight-handling bay with container seals, manifest scanners, and automated pallet movers for rapid package assembly and breakdown. Even this entry-level installation works substantially faster than hand unpacking at a workshop.
station_facilities.name: Package Logistics Bay

station_facilities.description: A magnetic containment vessel that compresses and suspends charged particles from ion gas using superconductor coils. Produces stable ion solution at baseline rates for propulsion systems.
station_facilities.name: Ion Compression Chamber

station_facilities.description: A desk in the exchange hall with your name on a brass plate. The market clerks know your face now — small courtesies add up when fees are calculated.
station_facilities.name: Ledger Desk

station_facilities.description: A proper turret on a proper mount, throwing armor-piercing shot out to the middle distance. The workhorse of station defense: not clever, not fast, and entirely capable of putting a hole through a raider that thought a station was a soft target. The turret tracks smoothly through its arc, ready racks full.
station_facilities.name: Station Defense Turret

station_facilities.description: Your own roll-away toolkit installed at this station's workshop — sharper tools laid out the way you like them. Everything you hand-craft at this station's Station Workshop comes together faster. Only helps where it's installed.
station_facilities.name: Workshop Toolkit

station_facilities.description: Precision cutting apparatus with thermal management and energy crystal mounting stages. Uses palladium-enhanced focusing to reshape raw crystals into weapon-ready optics.
station_facilities.name: Crystal Refinery

station_facilities.description: Precision furnace that fuses silicon and nickel ore into semiconductor-grade composite substrates through controlled high-temperature sintering. Copper piping manages thermal distribution across the chamber.
station_facilities.name: Silicate Kiln

station_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

station_facilities.description: The galaxy's premier entertainment and dining district. Restaurants, lounges, neural arcades, and luxury shopping — all hungry for imported goods. Restaurants are packed, neural arcades pulse with light, and credits flow freely. The Promenade buzzes with the galaxy's best entertainment and dining.
station_facilities.name: Haven Promenade

station_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
station_facilities.name: Hiring Board

station_facilities.description: A straightforward fermentation vessel with basic steel construction and simple control systems for continuous biological culture generation. Passive circulation maintains steady fermentation rates.
station_facilities.name: Fermentation Vat

station_facilities.description: A precision production line that fuses silicon and copper components under controlled thermal conditions, using a single energy crystal per cycle to sinter the integrated circuit matrix.
station_facilities.name: Circuit Fabricator

station_facilities.name: Siege Lance

station_facilities.description: Compact production line for electromagnetic disruption charge packs. Circuit board and superconductor integration is managed by precision control systems to produce standardized EM weapon magazine loads.
station_facilities.name: EM Charge Press

station_facilities.description: A basic sleeping berth in the station's communal quarters. A thin mattress, a locker that sticks, and a curtain for privacy. Not much — but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Crew Bunk

station_facilities.description: A shared storage box tucked behind some crates in the docks. Not much, but it's yours.
station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox

station_facilities.description: An expanded facility with parallel assembly stations and integrated electrical testing systems. Multiple processing cores manage component staging, solder-point verification, and capacity validation for each completed cell.
station_facilities.name: Electrochemical Cell Factory

station_facilities.description: A maker's market with rented workbenches and a community of artisans who'll teach you their secrets for the right price. Workbenches hum with activity, artisans mentoring students over excellent coffee. Tools are sharp, materials stocked, and the creative energy is palpable.
station_facilities.name: Haven Maker's Market

station_facilities.description: Basic industrial stamping and welding line for producing standardized cargo containers from steel plate and aluminum sheet. Automated press cycles and basic seam welding ensure consistent form factor.
station_facilities.name: Cargo Container Fabricator

station_facilities.description: A high-density capacitor bank and cryogenic cell array. Carries enough charge to ride out coincident burst loads across the entire industrial deck. Cryogenics hold the array at operating temperature; charge readouts run within tolerance through the worst production beats. The grid sees the reactor as if it were producing whatever the station happens to need that tick.
station_facilities.name: Capacitor Array

station_facilities.description: What you build when you have decided that the station will not be taken. A bastion projects a screen a raiding party can throw itself at all day, and it consumes cells and coolant at a rate that would keep a small fleet flying. It holds exactly as long as the warehouse does. The bastion is up. The screen is a solid wall and the supply clerks are weeping.
station_facilities.name: Shield Bastion

station_facilities.description: A cold, spotless cure station for the rarest raw plate in the galaxy.
station_facilities.name: Rainbow Leviathan Carpaccio Galley

station_facilities.description: Premium storage suites with concierge service. The Federation will catalog, appraise, and display your collection if you pay extra. Climate-controlled suites maintain perfect conditions, the AI concierge locating any item in under three seconds. Display windows on the Promenade shine.
station_facilities.name: Haven Premium Storage

station_facilities.description: A specialized production line that combines circuit boards, energy crystals, and copper wiring into compact power cells through automated assembly and containment processes.
station_facilities.name: Power Cell Assembler

station_facilities.description: A swarm of hull drones on a charging rack, which crawl out between engagements and weld the station back together a plate at a time. They are slow, they are relentless, and they will not save you during a fight — but a station with a repair dock heals what a station without one simply carries forever. The drones are out and working. The hull integrity readout is, very slowly, going the right way.
station_facilities.name: Automated Repair Dock

station_facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.
station_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

station_facilities.description: Purpose-built assembly for focused crystal alignment and superconductor integration. Produces defensive projector units at steady industrial pace.
station_facilities.name: Shield Emitter Production Line

station_facilities.description: Industrial assembly plant with enhanced thermal management and plasma control systems. Faster integration cycles and improved component bonding yield more stable cross-empire composite matrices.
station_facilities.name: Synthesize Pan-Galactic Matrix Plant

station_facilities.description: A compact production line that stamps and bonds steel plates with flex polymer into standardized emergency repair kits. Steady output feeds station maintenance crews with reliable hull-patching supplies.
station_facilities.name: Repair Kit Factory

station_facilities.description: Hardens raw cipher chips into tamper-proof authenticators for permanent commercial installation — Stage 2 of Haven's transaction verification monopoly. Output flows directly into the Federation Treasury's bond reserve, not the public market.
station_facilities.name: Haven Authenticator Foundry

station_facilities.description: The galaxy's largest ship showroom with models from every empire on display. The sales staff work on commission and it shows. Every display ship polished to a mirror finish under artful lighting. Sales staff circulate with practiced charm, and the order books are full.
station_facilities.name: Haven Ship Showroom

station_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.
station_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

station_facilities.description: Scaled production with reinforced structural frames and improved crystal-focusing optics, tripling output efficiency through parallel processing.
station_facilities.name: Field Fabrication Lab

station_facilities.description: Specialized thermal-bonding facility that sinters alumina ceramic with titanium alloy under controlled high heat. Plasma injectors hold the precise temperature profile needed to form silicon-free ceramic-metal composite sheets.
station_facilities.name: Alumina Sintering Kiln

station_facilities.description: A larger facility with multiple processing cores and sensor arrays that streamline crystal integration and electrical wiring, significantly reducing cycle time through parallel assembly stages.
station_facilities.name: Automated Power Cell Plant

station_facilities.description: Tiered grow-racks and a nitrogen-mist rig running one slow, heavy bed of sunspindle cereal at a time.
station_facilities.name: Sunspindle Bay

station_facilities.description: A compact single-stage compressor that cools and pressurizes hydrogen gas into liquid form. Suitable for steady fuel production at modest scales.
station_facilities.name: Hydrogen Compression Cylinder

station_facilities.description: A heavy-duty assembly line that bonds structural frames with durasteel plating, titanium alloy bracing, and graphene sheets into reinforced skeletons. Designed to produce the load-bearing frames required for capital-scale industrial equipment.
station_facilities.name: Reinforced Frame Fabrication Line

station_facilities.description: Warm, humid orchard cells ripening sugar-heavy honeyglobe under full-spectrum lamps.
station_facilities.name: Honeyglobe Orchard

station_facilities.description: The largest open market in the galaxy. Three decks, every empire represented, cipher-secured. Or it was. A third of the stalls sit empty, cipher verification backing up at every terminal. Traders cluster around the few working stations, tempers fraying.
station_facilities.name: Haven Grand Bazaar

station_facilities.description: A run-down apartment a bit too close to the water recyclers. Smells like ozone, but it's home.
station_facilities.name: Faction Quarters

station_facilities.description: A dedicated production line that cuts, bends, and welds steel plates into girder skeletons, then integrates copper piping runs for internal systems. Output is steady and reliable for basic facility construction.
station_facilities.name: Steel Frame Assembly Line

station_facilities.description: The Federation's primary fleet command and supply center. Contracts are performance-based, supply chains are optimized, and crew incentive packages are the most competitive in the galaxy. Cipher authentication has stalled for want of stock and vintage reserves are critically low. Two patrol wings have triggered contract performance clauses. The fleet operations director is, for the first time, explaining an underperformance to the Trade Commission. The presentation is lengthy.
station_facilities.name: Haven Fleet Operations

station_facilities.description: A Confederacy composite press that bonds a coronid's sol-nacre with a steel charge into solarian composite, skipping the three-ore melt the crab already did in its shell.
station_facilities.name: Sol Nacre Press

station_facilities.description: A physical notice board near the docks. Your posted bounties compete for attention with lost pet notices and propaganda.
station_facilities.name: Notice Board

The recoil is taken by the station's own mass, because nothing smaller would survive it. The loading crews are working and the barrels are warm. Anything in the volume is in range.
station_facilities.name: Heavy Defense Battery

station_facilities.description: Full Nebula trade enforcement command. Every transaction in the system passes through here — or is supposed to. The Authority's jurisdiction is technically limited to trade violations, but 'trade violation' is a surprisingly flexible legal category. Real-time trade monitoring tracks every transaction, manifest, and cargo transfer in the system. Enforcement flotillas deploy on cost-optimized patrol routes. The seized goods warehouse turns a modest profit at quarterly auction, which the Federation considers an elegant solution.
station_facilities.name: Federation Trade Authority

station_facilities.description: A decompression rig that cracks crystallized bio-gas into standard fuel cells. Turns sift-ray harvests into the fuel every ship needs.
station_facilities.name: Biogas Cracker

station_facilities.description: A dedicated metal-working line with ore roasting, smelting, and drawing dies for copper wire and pipe stock. Produces standard-gauge piping suitable for station plumbing and coolant runs.
station_facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill

station_facilities.name: Faction Lockbox
